name: Seafood/Market service area behind the counter run (staff only). The counter is the ~9 pt band the PDF draws from (1102,372) east along y=372 to the wall and down its x=1102/1111 face to the angled front ending at (1133,441); the block it encloses — up to the east wall at x=1182 — is empty prep space with no fixture and no product label, and its only floor link is the ~12 pt staff gap between that counter end and the produce wall case starting at (1145,445). The customer side (the aisle west of x=1102 with the two angled seafood cases, and the corridor south of the counter at x 1116-1142) stays walkable, so the SEAFOOD VERIFY at (1127,399) is a staff area, not frontage.

West checkstand bank, lane interiors (audit 2026-07-27) — the register/belt/bagging assemblies from x=386 to x=550, y 584-623. Store 92 draws its lanes as ~4 pt gaps that are open at BOTH ends, so no enclosed pocket ever forms behind them and the derived auto:CHECKSTANDS zone (rect 343,521-756,631, bridge 20) has nothing to cull: the bank shipped fully green, and the shortest path from the front action alley to the post-checkout strip ran straight down a 0.43 m lane at x=665 (geodesic/euclid 1.04, against 1.95-6.60 on every other onboarded store; baseline 659 renders its bank solid white). 20 columns crossed the bank end to end. A checkout lane is not a corridor the router may thread mid-trip, so it is excluded like any other drawn-open-but-unusable floor. The rect stops at x=552 and starts at x=384, leaving the Ice-box/Tobacco walkway (x 552-626) and the bank's west approach (x 368-384) open, which is how a shopper actually gets from the alley to the Exit.

East checkstand bank, lane interiors (audit 2026-07-27) — same finding, same reasoning: the assemblies from x=628 to x=748, y 583-616. East edge 750 is the last register; the bank's east approach past x=750 into the Entrance/Carts vestibule stays open, as does the post-checkout strip at y 617-622 that runs beneath it to the Entrance.
